title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I would like to ask you regarding the permissibility of children (na-baligh) standing in the rows of adults in the masjid. In our masjid (in London, UK), 2 groups seem to have developed. 1 group says it is necessary for the children to stand in the rows at the back of the congregation during salaat, whereas the other says children should/can stand within the adult rows. Both groups quote different ulama to support their views. Can you please enlighten us with the BEST PRACTICE which should ideally be promoted and followed in our masjid (ie, what should we TRY to do in our masjid, regardless of whether the masallees will follow it or not)? 3494 views Q. I am following hanafi madhab....now i am in a place where all mosque imams are shafee madhab. 1)In 2nd rakat of fazar salat they ask dua after ruku and before sizda.what should i suppose to do at this time. 2)They offer bitr in ramzan in 2 1 basis.I heared we should offer bitr salat alone in this case.What to do? 3)Most of the imam after farz(obligatory)prayer ask dua loudly and muktadi say amin.I heared no reference are there for this.Is it so?what to do at this time. 3581 views Q. black dye for beard. 4037 views Q. I want to know dat if in masjid down the shaff is not full n peoply go up n pretend namaz is that right and will there namaz be qubool? 1562 views Q. If we do not perform daily nafl salah of Zuhr, Maghrib and Isha, is this gunah? 4986 views Q. during ramzan time for prayers no time to go mosque instead we pray in the work area or we should go to masjid compulsorily. 1715 views Q. I am from India & presently working in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I follow the Hanafi maslak. Sometimes due to work related travel I mis the jamat of Zohar salah. But I try to reach the masjid at the earliest to perform my Zohar salah. But sometime it happens that when I reach the masjid I find that Asar Jamat (as per Hambali timing) has started. But as per Hanafi salah timetable I still have time for our Zohar salah, as Asar time has not started as per Hanafi timetable. Now my question is what should I do? Do i read the Zohar salah first & then try to join the jamat of Asar which has already started may be the jamat may be over before I complete my Zohar salah. or I directly join the jamat for Asar salah & read my Zohar after that? I am very confused. But this happens only sometimes may be once in 3-4 months. 3561 views Q. Bismillah Assalamoalaikum! Is this true "Hadith", that if a person having unlimited "Qaza Sala'h" then on Last Friday of this Month of Ramadan, pray 4 raka't Nafil, in each raka't after Sura-e-Fatiha, recite 7 times Ayatul Kursi and 15 times Sura-e-Kauser. This Nafil Sala'h will be the Qaza or Kaffara for atleast Sala'h of 700 years. WallahuAlam, but I did not heared this thing before, please clarify my doubts, Allah will bless you. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 20832 Country: India Title: In continuation with my Q # 20145, about your querry. I am staying in Saudia along with my family.I used to visit India on vacation for approx 1 month every year along with my family. 1, Staying at Aligarh (my sasural). Case 1: less than 15 days. Case 2: more than 15 days. 2,Staying Bahraich(my native). Case 1: Less than 15 days. Case 2: more than 15 days. My baligh son born in Aligarh. Considering above conditions please reply where (Aligarh/Bahraich) my wife and son pray Qsr. Question: In continuation with my Q # 20145, about your querry. I am staying in Saudia along with my family.I used to visit India on vacation for approx 1 month every year along with my family. 1, Staying at Aligarh (my sasural). Case 1: less than 15 days. Case 2: more than 15 days. 2,Staying Bahraich(my native). Case 1: Less than 15 days. Case 2: more than 15 days. My baligh son born in Aligarh. Considering above conditions please reply where (Aligarh/Bahraich) my wife and son pray Qsr. Answer ID: 20832 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 533/399/D=1431) (1) When you, your wife and your adult children intend to stay more than fifteen days whether at Bahraich or Aligarh , all of you have to offer full salah. (2) You intend to stay less than fifteen days at Bahraich whereas you have not cancelled the nativity of Bahraich completely, you would offer complete salah. In the same way your wife and adult children in case of staying for less than fifteen days will perform full salah. And when you, your wife and children will intend to stay in Aligarh for less than fifteen days, all of you will do qasr. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
